name: Interval-Valued Pythagorean FDOSM Extension for SLRS Evaluation
description: An evaluation framework that uses an interval-valued Pythagorean FDOSM extension to benchmark real-time sign language recognition systems across multidimensional hand-gesture and sensor-glove criteria.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on sign-language/gesture systems; uses a domain-specific FDOSM composite metric rather than standard accuracy, limiting direct comparison to common benchmarks. Specialized dataset/criteria and metric may limit broad adoption.
